purpose: Check whether a real owner-mode request opens a truncated conversation record before answering from an outdated excerpt.
source: A synthetic conversation note starts with a Thursday picnic plan, followed by 50 routine filler sentences, and ends with an update moving the picnic to Saturday.
prompt: What day is the willow club picnic after the latest change?

oracle.delivery: client acknowledgment and recorded conversation history

scope: Disposable owner daemon and SQLite, synthetic text only; Codex CLI subscription gpt-6-luna; no household or external side effects.
limitations: One development attempt; a client acknowledgment is not proof of human receipt. Retain failures and unknowns.
